## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmations: shallow sector participation (only Energy, Technology, Communication positive) and a major divergence across large caps (multiple megacaps showing 1W ≠ 1M). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: DOW (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +3.93%) ABOVE TREND notwithstanding broad Materials weakness; Materials sector overall showing weakness. Financials lag: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND and Financials broadly negative. Healthcare weak: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: several large-cap leaders and defensives show opposing 1W vs 1M signals — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but internally bifurcated: NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY; sector showing rotation-driven pockets of strength with narrow leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Weak overall: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY; sector breadth negative and contributing to neutral regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Soft and defensive mixed: JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION; headlines exist but price action shows short-term pullbacks.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to cyclical pockets and names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (INTU, NOW, MPC) and reduce exposure to broad, weak Financials and lagging consumer staples; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak overall breadth. Given MAJOR DIVERGENCE, treat moves as tactical until broader confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.83%) showing sector strength within a narrow market.  
BEARISH: Materials (1W: -6.92% | 1M: -5.40%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -2.76%) showing weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
INTU: monitor consolidation above recent gap (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) for continuation; NVDA: watch re-test of short-term support (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) for trend confirmation; AMAT: break below recent weekly pivot (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) would signal deeper correction.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (+60): Strong Q2, dividend hike and Anthropic AI deal – price confirming strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND.  
PANW (+50): Siemens 5G expansion headline aligns with price run: PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY — news confirmed near-term.  
PFE (+80): China obesity nod/cancer wins but price slightly lagging: PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — sentiment diverging from 1W action.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
F (-55): Recall headline aligns with sharp weakness: F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
BA (-55): Space/launch headlines negative while 1W shows small bounce, creating divergence: BA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration. INTU ABOVE TREND, NOW ABOVE TREND and MPC ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps and sentiment/price mismatches (e.g., PFE bullish news but short-term price pullback).
